These filters are a good value and replace an LG refrigerator water filter LT1000P.

Once you actually get them installed - they work great and the resulting water tastes great as well.

My biggest beef with these are that they do not install easily.

When I replace a water filter in my refrigerator - I don't expect to struggle with what should be a simple task.

For this filter, both removal of the previous filter AND installation of the new filter are unnecessarily difficult.

Whether this is the fault of the filters or my LG fridge is not 100% clear, but I don't recall struggling as much with my original LG filter.

Basically, removing it is a slight pain - you have to twist counter-clockwise - very hard. It almost feels like you're going to break the fridge connection.

Installing the new one is even more difficult. Sounds crazy, but it's true. You have to really use quite a bit of force to screw it in clockwise until it locks in place - again, it feels like you're going to break the damn fridge.

Once that is accomplished however, these filters truly shine. There are no water leaks, and as I mentioned earlier, the water tastes fantastic.

So - do I recommend them? Yes. However, maybe I'm naive, but I feel like removing and installing should be as simple as a slight pull/push and a twist.
Sadly, that's not the case here, which is why I give this a 4-star review rather than
